corpus.name: GitHub Typo Corpus
corpus.license: MIT (repository license); individual texts follow their source repositories' terms
corpus.citation: Hagiwara & Mita, 'GitHub Typo Corpus: A Large-Scale Multilingual Dataset of Misspellings and Grammatical Errors', LREC 2020 (arxiv 1911.12893)

extraction.rule: same token count, exactly one differing token, both sides pure letters (<=16 chars, or <=6-char diff core for sentence-like CJK tokens), lowercased, symmetric punctuation stripped

full.ranking: rank of the correction among the tier's whole vocabulary by cosine to the typo, excluding the typo itself (ties counted optimistically)

fluency.ranking: rank of the correction among the tier's whole vocabulary by cosine to the typo, excluding the typo itself (ties counted optimistically)

mini.ranking: rank of the correction among the tier's whole vocabulary by cosine to the typo, excluding the typo itself (ties counted optimistically)
